comment: Strengths: A major strength is that the guidance treats digital health infrastructure as more than a technical interoperability problem. Its attention to governance, responsible use of emerging technologies, trustworthy AI, and human oversight provides an important foundation for health systems that must remain safe, equitable, and accountable as AI capabilities become more deeply integrated into care and public health infrastructure.
